skills.name: Unbound Blaze of Kindling
skills.description: Passive: Zaojun collects 20% of the Energy consumed by allied units and stores it as Hearthfires, up to 1200 Hearthfires can be stored. Active: Deals DMG equal to 400% of ATK to 3 units and nearby units. For every 300 Hearthfires she has, consumes the same amount of Hearthfires to make this skill hit 1 additional unit. (Target selection rules: Selects targets in order from farthest to nearest. Prioritizes Deities over Minions. If the number of targets is less than the amount of Hearthfires, targets may be selected repeatedly.)

upgrades.level2: For every 240 Hearthfires she has, this skill hits 1 additional unit.
upgrades.level3: For every 200 Hearthfires she has, this skill hits 1 additional unit.
upgrades.level4: For every 150 Hearthfires she has, this skill hits 1 additional unit.

skills.name: Feast of Warding
skills.description: Throws food to restore HP equal to 200% ATK to the frontmost allied unit. After the projectile hits, it ricochets to enemy units, dealing DMG equal to 50% of the front-row ally's ATK + 20% of their max HP.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 80% of this front-row ally's ATK + 20% of their Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Deals DMG equal to 80% of this front-row ally's ATK + 25% of their Max HP.
upgrades.level4: Deals DMG equal to 100% of this front-row ally's ATK + 30% of their Max HP.

skills.name: Everburning Hearthfire
skills.description: Passive: Zaojun no longer deals Normal Attacks, but restores 80 Energy to herself every 3s and gains 10% ATK, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Hearthbound Protection
skills.description: Upon entering battle, forms a Fire Pact with the allied unit with the highest HP. Fire Pact: The bound ally gains 15% DMG RED, and continuously sacrifices their own HP to keep Zaojun's HP no lower than their own.

upgrades.level2: The bound ally gains 19% DMG RED.
upgrades.level3: The bound ally gains 23% DMG RED.
upgrades.level4: The bound ally gains 27% DMG RED.

relic.name: Fire of Lasting Grace
relic.description: 30% of the Energy consumed by the Fire Pact-bound ally will be stored by Zaojun.

upgrades.level2: 15% of the DMG dealt by Zaojun will heal the Fire Pact-bound ally.
upgrades.level3: 25% of the DMG dealt by Zaojun will heal the Fire Pact-bound ally.
upgrades.level4: 80% of the Energy consumed by the Fire Pact-bound ally will be stored by Zaojun.
